title: Numbering restarts odt 002
notes: real ODF list numbering: text:list-style "L2" declaring three levels — text:num-format "1" / "a" / "i" (decimal/lowercase-letter/lowercase-roman, start-value 1 on level 1) — used by a 3-deep nested text:list-item tree and a second top-level list with text:continue-numbering="false" restarting the counters. ODF restart semantics stated honestly: text:continue-numbering DEFAULTS to false, so a sibling text:list sharing a list-style does not continue the previous counter anyway — the explicit text:continue-numbering="false" pins the restart (continuation would require "true"); text:start-value on the level style sets the per-level start. Reference text is the exact item strings only — the number markers are render-derived, never in the file as text. No normative counter matches list elements, so feature counts stay 0.
